caption:
At a new launch and told prices go up next phase? Here's who really holds the power. 🏗️

Most developers must sell every unit within five years of buying the land. Miss it, and they can lose a stamp duty remission worth up to 35% of the land price, plus interest. That's why unsold units near the deadline can come with better deals, while early phases are often priced to build momentum.

Before you commit, ask: how many units are left, and how long until their deadline?
